note: Maps a source path under art/ to one of the §17.11 load bundles.
This mapping has to be declared somewhere, because the two structures do not
line up: art/ is organised by asset TYPE (§17.8's tree — kits/chars/traps/
props/textures), while §17.11's bundles are organised by WHEN THE PLAYER
NEEDS THEM (boot, core, act1..3, audio). A prop is act1 or act2 depending on
which site it dresses, which no directory name can tell you.
Rules are ordered; the first whose `match` regex hits the art/-relative path
wins. Anything unmatched is reported by manifest.mjs as unassigned and FAILS
the build — an asset in no bundle is never scheduled to load, so silently
defaulting it would ship a game that is missing something at runtime.
